questions.question: Jesus told the lukewarm church in Laodicea that He was about to do what to them?

answers.text: Vomit them out of His mouth

questions.question: The church in Laodicea thought it was rich. What did Jesus say they did not realize they were?
Jesus said He stands at the door and knocks. If anyone opens it, what will He do?

answers.text: Come in and dine with them
Talk with them at the door
Walk with them down the road

questions.question: In His message to the church in Laodicea, what did Jesus promise to the one who overcomes?

answers.text: The right to sit with Him on His throne
A home inside the new Jerusalem
A crown of twelve shining stars
